questions.question_text: Match the word: ingredient
questions.correct_answer: One of the foods or substances used to make a dish
questions.explanation: An ingredient is a food or substance used to prepare a particular dish.

questions.question_text: Match the word: recipe
questions.correct_answer: A set of instructions for preparing a dish
questions.explanation: A recipe tells you what ingredients to use and how to cook a dish.

questions.question_text: Match the word: fry
questions.correct_answer: To cook food in hot oil or fat
questions.explanation: Fry means to cook food in hot oil or fat.

questions.question_text: Match the word: boil
questions.correct_answer: To cook food in hot water
questions.explanation: Boil means to cook food in water that is bubbling because of heat.

questions.question_text: Match the word: slice
questions.correct_answer: To cut food into thin, flat pieces
questions.explanation: Slice means to cut something into thin pieces.

questions.question_text: Match the word: peel
questions.correct_answer: To remove the skin of fruit or vegetables
questions.explanation: Peel means to remove the outer skin of fruit or vegetables.

questions.question_text: Match the word: mix
questions.correct_answer: To combine two or more things together
questions.explanation: Mix means to put different ingredients together.

questions.question_text: Match the word: delicious
questions.explanation: Delicious describes food that tastes very good.

questions.question_text: Flour, eggs and milk are the main ______ of this cake.
questions.explanation: Ingredients are the foods or substances used to make a dish.

questions.question_text: Can you give me the ______ for making chicken soup?
questions.explanation: A recipe gives instructions for preparing a dish.

questions.question_text: We usually ______ eggs in a little oil for breakfast.
questions.explanation: Fry means to cook food in hot oil.

questions.question_text: You should ______ the vegetables in hot water.
questions.explanation: Boil means to cook something in hot water.

questions.question_text: Please ______ the carrots into small pieces.
questions.explanation: Slice means to cut food into thin pieces.

questions.question_text: Remember to ______ the potatoes before cooking them.
questions.explanation: Peel means to remove the outer skin of a fruit or vegetable.

questions.question_text: Add the eggs and flour, then ______ them together.
questions.explanation: Mix means to combine different ingredients.

questions.question_text: This noodle soup is really ______. I want another bowl!
questions.explanation: Delicious means having a very good taste.

questions.question_text: What is a recipe?
questions.explanation: A recipe tells us the ingredients and steps needed to prepare food.

questions.question_text: Which verb means 'cook food in hot oil'?
questions.explanation: Fry means to cook food in hot oil or fat.

questions.question_text: Which verb means 'remove the skin of a fruit'?
questions.explanation: Peel means to remove the outer skin of fruit or vegetables.

questions.question_text: Which container is commonly used for milk?
questions.explanation: Milk is often sold in cartons.

questions.question_text: Which word is used with chocolate?
questions.explanation: We commonly say 'a bar of chocolate'.

questions.question_text: Which phrase is correct?
questions.explanation: A bottle of water is a correct expression for a quantity of water in a bottle.

questions.question_text: What does 'delicious' mean?
questions.explanation: Delicious describes food that tastes very good.

questions.question_text: Which action should you do before boiling potatoes?
questions.explanation: We often peel potatoes before cooking them.

questions.question_text: What does 'slice the bread' mean?
options: Remove the skin of the bread
questions.explanation: Slice means to cut something into thin pieces.

questions.question_text: This dish is very ______. (TASTE)
questions.explanation: Tasty is an adjective meaning having a good taste.

questions.question_text: My mother is a good ______. (COOK)
questions.explanation: Cook can be a noun referring to a person who prepares food.

questions.question_text: The food smells ______. (DELIGHT)
questions.explanation: Delightful is an adjective formed from delight.

questions.question_text: Follow the ______ carefully to make the cake. (INSTRUCT)
questions.explanation: Instructions are directions explaining how to do something.

questions.question_text: We need three main ______ for this dish. (INGREDIENT)
questions.explanation: Ingredient is a countable noun. The plural form is ingredients.

questions.question_text: Find and correct the vocabulary mistake: I boil the fish in hot oil.
questions.explanation: Fry means to cook food in hot oil. Boil means to cook food in hot water.

questions.question_text: Find and correct the vocabulary mistake: Please mix the apple before eating it to remove its skin.
questions.explanation: Peel means to remove the skin of fruit or vegetables.

questions.question_text: Find and correct the vocabulary mistake: A recipe is a person who cooks food.
questions.correct_answer: a person who cooks food → instructions for making a dish
questions.explanation: A recipe is a set of cooking instructions, not a person.

questions.question_text: Find and correct the vocabulary mistake: My mother bought a bottle of chocolate at the supermarket.
questions.correct_answer: a bottle of chocolate → a bar of chocolate
questions.explanation: A bar of chocolate is the common expression for a solid block of chocolate.

questions.question_text: Find and correct the vocabulary mistake: This soup tastes terrible. It is very delicious.
questions.explanation: Delicious means very tasty, so it does not match the negative meaning of the first sentence.

questions.question_text: Nam cuts a cucumber into thin, flat pieces. What is he doing?
questions.explanation: Slicing means cutting food into thin pieces.

questions.question_text: Lan puts carrots, potatoes and meat into hot water to cook them. What is she doing?
questions.explanation: Boiling means cooking food in hot water.

questions.question_text: A shop sells milk in a rectangular paper container. What is this container called?
questions.explanation: A carton is a container commonly used for milk and juice.

questions.question_text: You are making a cake and need flour, eggs, sugar and butter. What are these items called?
questions.explanation: Ingredients are the items used to prepare a dish.

questions.question_text: After tasting the chicken soup, everyone says it tastes wonderful. Which adjective can describe it?
questions.explanation: Delicious means having a very pleasant taste.
